spans.quotation: In 2024, estimated methane emissions totaled 2.3 million tonnes of CO₂e and constituted approximately 14% of our total GHG emissions. As of year-end 2024, we have achieved an approximate 64% methane emissions intensity reduction from 2015 with an intensity of 3.2 kg CO2e/BOE. We have both a near-term and medium-term target for reducing methane emissions: By 2025: Meet a 10% methane emissions intensity reduction target by 2025 from a 2019 baseline. By 2030: Achieve a near-zero methane emissions intensity by 2030. This near-zero target is defined as 1.5 kg CO2e/BOE or approximately 0.15% of natural gas produced. Our path to near-zero methane emissions by 2030 includes: Maintaining sound operating practices, including aerial and ground-based surveys for leak detection to identify fugitive emissions events. Focusing on eliminating pneumatics. Minimizing flare downtime. Managing emissions from thief hatches. Participating in OGMP 2.0 with a focus on mitigation. Evaluating and executing emissions reduction opportunities including our methane-related MACC projects.

After submitting our implementation plan in 2023, we were awarded OGMP 2.0's Gold Standard Pathway designation in recognition of achieving Level 5 for 97% of operated assets' reported methane emissions, a full three years ahead of the program requirement. In the International Methane Emissions Observatory 2023 Report, we were recognized as "leading performance at Level 5"; "ConocoPhillips' reporting is best in class this year. The company conducted an outstanding data reconciliation analysis that yielded a robust Level 5 estimate of their emissions for all material operating assets."

note: criteria 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 — 5 of 5. Criterion 1 satisfied by 2024 methane emissions of 2.3 million tonnes CO2e, intensity of 3.2 kg CO2e/BOE, and 64% reduction from 2015 baseline (Span 1, page 28), plus the five-year intensity series in Span 3 (page 74). Criterion 2 satisfied by two named targets: 10% methane intensity reduction by 2025 from a 2019 baseline, and near-zero (1.5 kg CO2e/BOE or 0.15% of gas produced) by 2030 (Span 1). Criterion 3 satisfied by OGMP 2.0 Level 5 reporting for 97% of operated assets (site/facility-level measurement with Level 4 source-level reconciliation) (Span 2, page 30) and named LDAR programme elements including aerial and ground-based surveys, pneumatic elimination, and thief hatch management (Span 1). Criterion 4 satisfied by 2025 near-term and 2030 medium-term explicit target years (Span 1). Criterion 5 satisfied by five-year methane intensity series 2020–2024 (3.4 / 2.6 / 2.6 / 4.8 / 3.2 kg CO2e/BOE) in the performance table (Span 3, page 74). uncertainty_discussed = true: Span 1 acknowledges uncertainty over near-term methane emissions levels due to regulatory reporting changes phasing in 2024–2025; Span 2 notes measurement technologies do not yield exact representations. Boundary note: flaring volumes and flaring intensity are the primary evidence for O2 and were not selected here. Methane content of flared gas (the Methane CO2e row in the performance table) touches both O1 and O2 — the flaring-specific rows were reserved for O2. The near-zero methane target (1.5 kg CO2e/BOE by 2030) also appears in M5 context but is the central operational target for O1 and is correctly selected here.
